+"""Directed soft code-assignment cross-entropy auxiliary objective."""

+import torch
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    """Match source assignments to behavior-associated target assignments."""
+    tau = float(parameters.get("tau", 0.5))
+    epsilon = float(parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-8))
+    if tau <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("tau must be positive")
+
+    source_dist = torch.softmax(-torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    target_dist = torch.softmax(-torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    per_pair = -(target_dist * torch.log(source_dist + epsilon)).sum(dim=-1)
+    weights = mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype, device=per_pair.device)
+    return (weights * per_pair).sum() / (weights.sum() + epsilon)
